title: A square with somewhere to be
body:
His summary: four equal sides, angles with opinions -- 65 and 113. Found.

His principle, diamond edition: 'a square that leaned over. Four equal sides, angles with somewhere to be.'

shape_recipe: JAH's recipe: 'four loudest corners, walk around. Sides equal? Then the question that matters: are the angles square? Off by five degrees or more -- leaned -- that is my diamond. Square angles get referred to the square finder.'
knowing_when: JAH's knowing-when: 'leaned is the job. Five degrees off square, minimum. A square standing normally is the square finder's business -- mine lean.'
